create.description: Whether to create the service account

roleArn.description: IAM role ARN for ALB controller service account

topologySpreadConstraints.description: The coredns pod topology spread constraints

dynamo.description: NVIDIA Dynamo platform configuration (Dynamo operator, Grove, KAI scheduler)

enabled.description: Whether to deploy the NVIDIA Dynamo platform

global.description: Placement of the Dynamo operator, Grove and KAI scheduler pods

affinity.description: Affinity of the Dynamo, Grove and KAI scheduler pods

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the Dynamo, Grove and KAI scheduler pods

tolerations.description: Tolerations for the Dynamo, Grove and KAI scheduler pods

enableCustomServiceAccounts.description: Whether to enable custom service account usage in InferenceEndpointConfigs

executionRoleArn.description: ARN of the execution role for the inference operator

affinity.description: Affinity of the Inference Gateway pod

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass for the Inference Gateway controller pod, influencing scheduling and preemption order. Unset leaves the pod at cluster default priority.

enabled.description: Whether to enable the Inference Gateway

globalRouting.description: Global routing settings for the VPC endpoint service the controller creates in front of the global routing Network Load Balancer when an InferenceGatewayConfig sets spec.globalRouting.enabled. Rendered into the global-inference-gateway-config ConfigMap.

allowedPrincipals.description: Comma-separated principals allowed to connect: service principals, or account, role or user ARNs (arn:aws:iam::<account>:root). Empty means the Global Inference Gateway service principal for the cluster's Region and stage. Never '*'.

executionRoleGroup.description: Kubernetes group the Global Inference Gateway's execution role is mapped to in the EKS access entry the customer creates on each cluster in a Global Inference Gateway. Bound to read InferenceGatewayConfigs and write the gig-membership ConfigMap, nothing else. Empty renders no binding, and the gateway cannot associate the cluster.

supportedRegions.description: Comma-separated extra Regions consumers may connect from. The cluster's own Region is always supported.

metricsPublisher.description: The Global Inference Gateway metrics publisher, which the controller deploys per tier-1 gateway in a Global Inference Gateway.

roleArn.description: IAM role ARN for the inference-gateway-metrics-publisher ServiceAccount, wired via IRSA. Allowed only kinesis:PutRecords on the gateway's metrics streams (SageMakerInferenceGateway docs/scripts/create-metrics-publisher-role.sh). Empty -> publishers run but cannot write.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the Inference Gateway pod

podAnnotations.description: Additional annotations to add to the Inference Gateway deployment pods

podLabels.description: Additional labels to add to the Inference Gateway deployment pods

resources.description: Resource requests/limits of the Inference Gateway container

roleArn.description: IAM role ARN for the SIG controller ServiceAccount (inference-gateway-controller). Wired via IRSA — annotated onto the SA at helm render time (matches the ALB Controller and KEDA pattern). Used by the auto-issue TLS flow (ACM) and, for configs with spec.globalRouting.enabled, to create and manage the VPC endpoint service in front of the global routing Network Load Balancer (EC2 and ELB describe permissions; see docs/IRSA-SETUP.md in SageMakerInferenceGateway). Provision the role out of band (the SageMakerInferenceGateway repo ships docs/scripts/create-cert-issuer-role.sh; production customers get it from Quick Setup CFN). Empty → auto-issue disabled and global routing reports GlobalRoutingUnavailable; the controller still supports HTTP-only and bring-your-own-ARN modes.

enabled.description: Whether to deploy the inference operator

jumpstartGatedModelDownloadRoleArn.description: ARN of the role for JumpStart gated model downloads

enabled.description: Whether to enable IRSA for KEDA

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the KEDA pod

podAnnotations.description: Additional annotations to add to the KEDA deployment pods

enabled.description: the option to enable managed PDB

maxUnavailable.description: maxUnavailable value for managed PDB, can be either string or integer; if it's string, should end with %

minAvailable.description: minAvailable value for managed PDB, can be either string or integer; if it's string, should end with %

podLabels.description: Additional labels to add to the KEDA deployment pods

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass for the KEDA operator, admission webhooks and metrics-server pods. Unset leaves them at cluster default priority.

resources.description: Resource requests/limits of the KEDA container

topologySpreadConstraints.description: The coredns pod topology spread constraints

logging.description: Operator logging configuration. CloudWatch publishing is opt-in and OFF by default; when enabled, a FluentBit sidecar ships the operator's structured logs to CloudWatch.

enabled.description: Whether to ship operator logs to CloudWatch via a FluentBit sidecar

logLevel.description: Log level for logs shipped to CloudWatch
Log level for the operator's console output

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass for the inference operator controller-manager pod, influencing scheduling and preemption order. Unset leaves the pod at cluster default priority.

tlsCertificateS3Bucket.description: S3 bucket name for storing TLS certificates
